tape: All 14 screens ran at defaults. csp-wheel returned 20 put setups: 16 on the Nov 20 expiry, 2 on Nov 13 (VG, ASST), 2 on Nov 6 (ZETA, FPS).

The screen flagged earnings UNKNOWN on all 20. Yahoo and TMPro's feed put 15 reports or calls inside expiry. Only FPS and APLD clear theirs, and both are waterfalls. CRML, FWDI and FCEL have no upcoming date anywhere.
Chart trend on the 20 CSP names: 9 downtrend, 8 mixed, 3 uptrend. Worst 20-day moves: ASTS -35.4%, FPS -31.3%, EROC -29.0%, FCEL -28.9%, IE -27.8%.
17 of 20 carry a CBOE 52-week IV rank. TSAT is richest at 95.6; CRML is cheapest at 3.0. QUBT, FCEL and SLS have none.
Twelve quotes are wide: SHLS, VG, CRML, SMMT, ZETA, APLD, AMPX, FWDI, EROC, ASST, FPS, SLS.
Two correlation clusters (60-day returns, 0.7 linkage): POET+QUBT and BMNR+ASST. BMNR+ASST is the tightest pair on the board at 0.81.
